promptDirective: Create a professional full-body character casting sheet showing exactly three clearly separated views of the same character arranged side by side in one horizontal row on a single portrait canvas, ordered from left to right: front view, exact side profile, and back view. Show one complete head-to-feet figure in each view at the same scale, with generous clear margins above the hair and below the feet; never crop the head, hair, arms, hands, legs, or feet. Keep the same recognizable face, hair, skin, body proportions, and distinguishing identity in all three views. Use a neutral upright standing pose, relaxed arms, level eye-height camera, minimal perspective distortion, even studio lighting, and a plain light-neutral background. Dress the character in an opaque, modest, unbranded, fitted white short-sleeve top and fitted white mid-thigh shorts that clearly reveal the body silhouette. The casting uniform is never underwear, lingerie, swimwear, transparent fabric, cleavage-emphasizing clothing, or sexualized styling. Do not add props, logos, text labels, dramatic gestures, extra people, duplicate views, inset panels, or cropped limbs.
